claim: Across the 10 years from 2016 to 2025, Amsterdam’s annual ERA5 precipitation ranged from 649.7 mm in 2025 to 1100.7 mm in 2023. The 1991–2020 annual mean was 777.4 mm.
reason: Source lists 2025 at 649.7 mm as driest and 2023 at 1100.7 mm as wettest for 2016-2025; baseline mean stated as 777.4 mm.
